author: Seung Wook
problem: files lists the file names of an archive's scanned film negatives. Return each name with its extension (the part from the last '.' on) removed, in the same order.
bug_description: Always cuts at name.rfind('.'), which is -1 for a name with no extension, so such names lose their last character.

comments.accurate: Scan file names with their extensions removed, in the same order
comments.wrong_behavior: Strips everything from the last dot, since every scan is saved with an extension
comments.wrong_location: Extension cut verified; check names with several dots keep everything before the last one
